g.text: WEB01 - UC2: read and update a product through REST
Proposed WEB05 integration using the existing BCK05 REST contract.
The product ID comes from the API and is reused for read, write and refresh.
The API checks the caller's permissions on every request.
Open the product selected from the list
Display the product and edit form
Recheck current roles on 401 / 403; no replay (SD3)
Explain failure and do not open the edit form
[Product loaded and manager submits a valid form]
PUT uses the complete writable BCK05 body.
The ID remains in the path.
Re-read the saved product by the same ID
Show saved data, or explain if the refresh failed
Recheck current roles on 401 / 403; no replay (SD3)
Show reason and keep unsaved input where appropriate
Re-read saved data before any manual retry
